The independent unequal-family certificate reconstructs every shifted numerator and denominator coefficient for G=C-I-lambda_I in two exhaustive disjoint cases, with positive coefficients and constants.

For every unequal integer triple 3<=a<=b<=c and theta<1, every unit insertion outside restoration or an internal pair in a largest part is strictly dominated by a fixed largest-part pair. With restoration forbidden these largest-part pairs are exactly all optimal insertions.

For a finite set of positive affine reduced objectives, maximum relative regret is attained at an uncertainty endpoint. Positive cross multiplication gives the two-action product rule. Weak domination alone does not preserve all minimizers, and removing actions merely absent from the oracle envelope can change the minimax value.
